summary: The study investigates the energy band alignment at the Zn1/C0xMgxO/Cu(In,Ga)Se2 interface for Cd-free Cu(In,Ga)Se2 solar cells using atomic layer deposition (ALD). The ALD process was used to deposit Zn1/C0xMgxO films with varying Mg content on CIGS absorbers. The valence band maximum (VBM) positions and bandgap energies of the Zn1/C0xMgxO films were determined, and the conduction band offset (CBO) at the interface was calculated. The results suggest that ALD Zn1/C0xMgxO films can serve as a promising alternative to CdS for environmental safety.
